purpose.zh: 练腰腹两侧，让身体不被拉着转
purpose.en: Train your core to keep your body from being twisted.

text.zh: 双手往前推直，身体别被拉转
text.en: Press your hands straight out and do not let your body turn

text.zh: 侧对固定点站直，双手握住把手放在胸前。
text.en: Stand tall side-on to the anchor with the handle at your chest.

text.zh: 推直后停两秒，再收回胸前。
text.en: Hold for two seconds, then bring your hands back to your chest.

commonErrors.en: Letting your body turn toward the anchor.

cautions.zh: 固定点不牢时先别开始
cautions.en: Do not start until the anchor is secure.

cautions.zh: 腰背不舒服时换更轻的弹力带
cautions.en: If your back feels uncomfortable, switch to a lighter band.

changes: 与 h-band-pallof 同一动画，purpose/cues 对齐其已审文案
节奏按 spec：推 0.9 s、停 2 s、收 0.75 s
EN 名 Banded Pallof Press 保留（Pallof 为通用名）
flags: EN 名含 Pallof（专有名），中文已是口语，若要统一成 h-band-pallof 的 Band Anti-Rotation Press 请定
